hero.subtitle: Avantee Industries Private Limited transforms post-consumer waste into luxury recycled yarns, eco-fibres, and high-tensile sustainable fabrics with zero-water compromise.

about.title: Architecting the Future of Eco-Conscious Textiles
about.desc1: Established as a trailblazer in circular textile engineering, Avantee Industries Private Limited operates state-of-the-art closed-loop recycling facilities.
about.desc2: We engineer GRS-certified recycled fibres, ring-spun yarns, and technical textiles trusted by luxury fashion houses, automotive giants, and industrial leaders worldwide.
about.missionText: To revolutionize textile production through 100% circular recycled materials while minimizing environmental footprint.
about.visionText: To lead global industrial manufacturing toward zero-carbon sustainable fabrics without compromising strength or softness.

products.title: Premium Recycled Yarns, Fibres & Fabrics
products.subtitle: Discover our comprehensive portfolio of GRS and OEKO-TEX certified sustainable textile solutions.

process.title: Our 6-Step Manufacturing Process
process.step1Desc: Ethically sourcing PET bottles and textile scraps globally.
process.step2Desc: Purifying polymer chips using non-toxic closed-loop water treatment.
process.step3Desc: Transforming clean polymer into micro-denier staple fibres.
process.step4Desc: Spinning consistent, uniform yarns across diverse count ranges.
process.step5Desc: Creating soft, durable fabrics with waterless color technology.
process.step6Desc: Spectrophotometer testing for ultimate tensile strength & purity.
